title: Report Readability Implementation Plan
summary: Task-by-task TDD implementation plan restructuring the sec-overlay human report: triage table, NDT view, dep view, markdown redteam serializer.
notes: Implementation plan with checkbox tasks, code, and tests. No ADR status/decision-consequences structure, no user stories, no API contract spec. Global Constraints section has SPEC-like invariants (epistemic honesty, determinism) but the dominant form is a work plan -> DOC. Filename hash suffix is a path-derived slug, not SHA-256 (no shell available to this classifier).
